run_findings.composite_branch_cas: Standalone update_ref(force=false) still lacks an expected-old-SHA parameter, but a direct staged sequence read H0 -> create tree -> create commit C with sole parent H0 -> non-force update_ref to C acts as an effective expected-head CAS under normal forward-only competing history: a sibling concurrent head is not an ancestor of C, so GitHub's fast-forward check rejects the update. This is a bounded protocol inference and is not claimed across force-push/history rewrite.
run_findings.stronger_unavailable_branch_cas: GitHub GraphQL createCommitOnBranch exposes explicit expectedHeadOid and is a stronger atomic benchmark. Current connected GitHub discovery exposes no generic GraphQL mutation/createCommitOnBranch action, so it is public GitHub capability but not inspected Chat-direct capability.
run_findings.file_lease_claim: For reusable claims on the current connector, deterministic lease files are preferable to refs: Contents create/update/delete is exposed with blob-SHA CAS, while no delete-ref action is exposed. Claim metadata can mirror Kubernetes Lease fields, but safe stale reclaim additionally requires participant no-effect-after-expiry discipline, renewal margin, bounded clock-skew/grace, and exact current-blob CAS on delete.
run_findings.pr_create_ambiguity: PR creation has no documented idempotency key. Use deterministic head/base, search/list before create, and after timeout/422 search same head/base then exact get_pr_info verification before any retry. A moved/conflicting candidate is not recovered success.
run_findings.status_checks_boundary: GitHub officially distinguishes commit statuses from Checks and GitHub Actions produces Checks. Connected get_commit_combined_status plus the PR-triggered/first-page workflow-run wrapper must therefore not be treated as complete CI/Checks coverage. Bind all visible evidence to exact head SHA and classify missing evidence as unknown; server-side branch protection can remain the authoritative final gate.
run_findings.review_merge_binding: Freeze PR head H, collect head-bound evidence, submit review with commit_id=H, re-read head, then synchronously merge with expected_head_sha=H. Any head drift invalidates the evidence/review bundle. Ambiguous merge responses require read-before-retry.
run_findings.workflow_dispatch_boundary: Fresh workflow_dispatch remains available in public GitHub REST but absent from connected discovery this invocation; only readback/rerun-existing-run actions were exposed. Writing workflow YAML or rerunning an existing run is not equivalent to starting a fresh Chat-direct execution.
